## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: When this story is complete, the existing "Suppress prior defenses for integration review" step at ci.yml:523 is updated to filter on the new (pr_number, commit_sha) shape. The filter rewrite ships with a behavioral test exercising sub-PR defense \xe2\x86\x92 session\xe2\x86\x92main suppression round trip.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/workflows/test-ci-suppress-prior-defenses-round-trip.sh`.

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given:
  - A TrackerDefenseStore populated with a defense record for `pr_number=42, commit_sha=abc123, finding fingerprint F1`.
  - DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES=true environment variable set (simulating ci.yml:523 having fired).
  - A simulated integration review on a session\xe2\x86\x92main PR (pr_number=99) where commit_sha=abc123 is one of the covered sub-PR SHAs.
  - A candidate findings list including finding F1 (same fingerprint as PR 42's prior defense).
- When: `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` (or wherever the consumer is wired by T10) is invoked.
- Then: F1 is FILTERED OUT of the active findings list passed to the LLM (suppressed because a sub-PR defense already covers it).

The test must fail RED because the DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES consumer has been documented intent ONLY since PR #140 (see ci.yml:523 inline comment) \xe2\x80\x94 no code reads or acts on the flag yet.

Test asserts both:
1. The filter step's new key shape (pr_number-aware) works correctly.
2. The previously-missing consumer wiring actually filters findings during integration review.

Update `.test-index` with RED marker `[test_ci_suppress_prior_defenses_round_trip]` for both `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh` (the consumer target).

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/workflows/test-ci-suppress-prior-defenses-round-trip.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] tests/workflows/test-ci-suppress-prior-defenses-round-trip.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/workflows/test-ci-suppress-prior-defenses-round-trip.sh
- [ ] Test is initially RED (consumer wiring not yet implemented; filter not yet rewritten)
  Verify: ! bash tests/workflows/test-ci-suppress-prior-defenses-round-trip.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_ci_suppress_prior_defenses_round_trip\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Test exercises BOTH the ci.yml filter step AND the consumer wiring (round-trip)
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES' tests/workflows/test-ci-suppress-prior-defenses-round-trip.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
